item.title: Hubble Network on a Silicon Labs xG24: +20 dBm radio board, Eight Weeks on a Budapest Roof, Zero Packets
item.description: We brought up Hubble's direct-to-satellite BLE on an EFR32xG24, measured it at 2.482 GHz, and found out why eight weeks in Budapest gave zero packets.
